origin.basis: Giant Group was founded in 1972 in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: Giant does not state where this tire is made.

hookless_note: Giant's UK product page labels it 'Hookless compatible'; check the wheel maker's tire list and pressure limit.

wet_notes.summary: Giant names winter training and wet rides and claims an endurance tread pattern for better wet and mixed-terrain grip; no independent wet test found.

availability.note: Sold by Giant's UK web store; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this model.

name: Gavia Fondo 1 Tubeless
positioning: Lower-cost 60 TPI version of the Gavia Fondo winter and wet-weather endurance tire.
caveats: Wet grip is a maker claim; no independent wet test found.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. UK VAT on 2026-11-01; one tire; delivery terms at checkout.

image.shown: Gavia Fondo 1 Tubeless as pictured on Giant's product page.
image.alt: Giant Gavia Fondo 1 tubeless road tire shown as a full ring

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components review lists and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this exact model; shop and promotional posts, questions, mounting-only impressions, generic praise and reports about other models were left out.

reports.summary: The stock 32 mm tire lasted about 15,000 km in 18 months with only small tread cuts; a staple caused no air loss until it was pulled out.

checks.note: One owner post; a shop fitting post is not counted
